record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: What are the strong asymptotics of monic Sobolev orthogonal polynomials when the two measures in the Sobolev inner product are absolutely continuous Szegő-class measures with disjoint, or at least noncoincident, supports?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 4.2. What is the strong asymptotics of {Q_n} if μ_0, μ_1 are absolutely continuous measures from the Szegő class with disjoint or at least non-coincident supports?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mu_0$ and $\mu_1$ be two finite positive Borel measures on the real line (or on rectifiable Jordan curves/arcs) that are absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue (arc-length) measure and that belong to the Szegő class, meaning $\int \log \mu_j'\, d\omega_j > -\infty$ with respect to the appropriate equilibrium measure $\omega_j$ on $\operatorname{supp}(\mu_j)$, $j=0,1$. Define the Sobolev inner product
$$\langle f, g \rangle_S \;=\; \int f\,\overline{g}\, d\mu_0 \;+\; \int f'\,\overline{g'}\, d\mu_1,$$
and let $\{Q_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ denote the sequence of monic polynomials orthogonal with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$, so that $Q_n$ has degree $n$ and $\langle Q_n, p \rangle_S = 0$ for every polynomial $p$ of degree less than $n$.

Assume that the supports $\operatorname{supp}(\mu_0)$ and $\operatorname{supp}(\mu_1)$ are disjoint, or at least noncoincident (i.e. neither is contained in the other). Determine the strong (Szegő-type) asymptotic behavior of $Q_n(z)$ as $n \to \infty$ for $z$ in the appropriate exterior region of the complex plane: namely, find an explicit limit of the form
$$\lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{Q_n(z)}{\Phi_n(z)} \;=\; F(z),$$
where $\Phi_n$ is a suitable normalizing sequence (e.g. powers of the conformal map onto the exterior of the relevant support) and $F$ is an explicit analytic function expressible in terms of Szegő functions associated with $\mu_0$ and $\mu_1$.
artifact.status_search_result: Search returned a number of papers on strong asymptotics for Sobolev orthogonal polynomials and for Szegő-class orthogonal polynomials with disjoint supports (e.g. Angelesco-system results), as well as Bernstein–Szegő theorems for Sobolev orthogonal polynomials. However, no single source clearly resolves the general question of strong asymptotics for monic Sobolev orthogonal polynomials when the two Szegő-class measures have disjoint or noncoincident supports. Partial results exist but full resolution is not confirmed by the search.

status_evidence.title: Strong asymptotics for Sobolev orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Strong asymptotics for Sobolev orthogonal polynomials are obtained under Szegő-type conditions on the measures.
status_evidence.claim: Strong asymptotics have been studied for Sobolev orthogonal polynomials with Szegő-class measures, but typically not under the assumption of disjoint supports.

status_evidence.title: Bernstein–Szegő's Theorem for Sobolev Orthogonal Polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Extension of Bernstein–Szegő results to the Sobolev setting.
status_evidence.claim: Partial Bernstein–Szegő-type asymptotic results exist for Sobolev orthogonal polynomials.

status_evidence.title: Strong Asymptotics of Multiple Orthogonal Polynomials for Angelesco Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Pairwise disjoint closed intervals with Szegő-class measures on each interval; strong asymptotics obtained.
status_evidence.claim: Related disjoint-support, Szegő-class strong-asymptotics results exist for Angelesco multiple orthogonal polynomials, but not directly for the Sobolev inner product.
